prompt: Write a one-star review of the Grand Canyon from a visitor who feels it was too big.
response:
# ★☆☆☆☆ Way Too Big. Completely Unnecessary.

**Reviewed by: Gerald P.**

Look, I don't leave one-star reviews lightly, but somebody has to say it: the Grand Canyon is simply too much canyon.

I drove four hours to see this thing, and when I got there, I couldn't even see all of it. What kind of attraction can't be viewed in its entirety? I stood at the rim for twenty minutes, walked to another viewpoint, and guess what? MORE canyon. It just kept going. At no point did it end. That's poor planning, in my opinion.

A reasonable canyon should be viewable in 15-20 minutes, tops. This one is apparently 277 miles long. Who has time for that? I certainly don't. Nobody needs that much geology.

Also, it's a mile deep. A MILE. For what? You can't even see the bottom properly from the top. If I wanted to squint at something far away, I could've stayed home and looked at my neighbor's shed. The river down there looked like a little ribbon. Very underwhelming for something they call "mighty."

The size also makes photos impossible. I tried to get the whole thing in one picture and couldn't. My wife suggested a "panorama" but I shouldn't have to learn new phone features because a hole in the ground doesn't know when to quit.

To top it off, when I asked a park ranger when they were planning to finish it or at least fence off a smaller, more manageable section, she just laughed. Very unprofessional.

Save yourself the trip. Find a nice, modest ditch closer to home. Two stars off for size, one for the ranger, one for the gift shop being out of my size in t-shirts, and one because the "grand" in the name really oversells the whole—actually no, the name is the only accurate part.

One star. Would not canyon again.
